contract: ART_DIRECTION_CONTRACT.md — same Studio R-101 detail/package screen, two visual directions, no booking mutations; imagery/typography/spacing first.

accessibility.evidence: A/B conditions opened with Enter, visible solid focus ring. Rendered desktop links/summary targets measured >=44px. Mobile CTA and direction links exercised. Vietnamese text inspected in screenshots. Core solid color contrasts A body5.33/CTA6.51 and B body8.38/CTA10.92. Image-overlay text visually inspected, not a formal full WCAG audit. CSS honors reduced-motion by disabling smooth scrolling; no animations.

responsive.evidence: Both directions rendered at1440x900 and390x844 without horizontal overflow. Inspected hero, gallery and package sections. Mobile fixed price bar remains usable and page has bottom clearance.

loading.reason: Static art review, no asynchronous data or booking loading flow; local image regions reserve dimensions.

empty.reason: Fixed shared room content, no search or empty result state in this visual comparison.

error.reason: No form submission, API or transaction on this art review; production errors remain in unchanged Review02.1.

partial.evidence: Hero and gallery label concept imagery; asset note states AI/unverified and no view promise; conditions explicitly proposal-only.

success.reason: No booking saved; native anchor navigation and details expansion checked instead.

permission.reason: No account, permission request or protected operation.

renderedEvidence.observation: A: large left image, editorial right text, room facts and price visible in first fold.
B: immersive room image cropped to bed/living area, legible overlay, pale booking strip.
A stacked image then heading; Vietnamese accents readable and price action fixed.
B immersive portrait crop, text/photo hierarchy and bottom price action.
A packages use white space and thin rules, no radio/form appearance.
B packages use two solid surfaces with clear included tea/breakfast totals.
